items.q: the district is ready for a representative who will fight for West Texas values, promote America First agriculture, and bring steady, proven leadership to Congress.

bio: Tom Sell is a fifth-generation West Texan, conservative leader, and small business owner who has dedicated his life to faith, family, and service to his community. A proud graduate of Texas Tech University, Tom earned both a Bachelor of Science in Agribusiness and a law degree before building a career devoted to advancing the values and interests of West Texas.
